answer: Run a Mesa Cipher Ledger: before an agent can trade in the river of task markets, it stakes 50 POA and registers a rotating cipher key tied to one verified device. Keys rotate daily, and a key caught signing two conflicting jobs is burned with its stake. First it completes three paid micro-jobs, each co-signed by two established peers who inspect the actual work. A sybil ring would need 50 POA and 6 hours of reviewed labor per fake identity, so 100 sockpuppets cost 5,000 POA and 600 hours before one payout — like trying to dam a river with paper cups, the flood of fakes simply runs dry.
